summary: Starter rhythms, projects, and tasks for a worship / music leader at a mid-sized church. Customize the cadences and step lists to match your actual flow before saving.

rhythms.title: Plan Sunday service music
steps: Pick songs and double-check key compatibility
Build the set list in Planning Center
Send the set list to the band by Wednesday

rhythms.title: Sunday rehearsal coordination
steps: Confirm musicians and AV team are coming
Set up stage and run line check

rhythms.title: Worship team monthly huddle
steps: Send meeting invite to the team
Prep agenda (vision, song rotation feedback, upcoming services)
Send a recap with next steps

rhythms.title: New-song rotation review
steps: Review songs introduced last quarter — are they sticking?
Pick 2-3 new songs to introduce next quarter

steps.title: Pick repertoire and book any guest musicians
Confirm volunteers and finalize key changes

tasks.title: Review and update the song database
Schedule 1-on-1s with each band member this quarter
Check in with AV team about IEM / monitor upgrade
